Convert SQL to PySpark:
```sql
select country, avg(rating) as avg_rating
from suppliers
group by country
having avg(rating) > (select avg(rating) from suppliers);
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

avg_rating = df_suppliers.agg(F.avg("rating")).first()[0]

result = (
    df_suppliers
    .groupBy("country")
    .agg(F.avg("rating").alias("avg_rating"))
    .filter(F.col("avg_rating") > avg_rating)
)
```
